title: Iki rules and guards (iki/v1)
description: Rules a type's records keep at every save (ADR 0127), and guards on setting a state (ADR 0128). Expressions are Google's Common Expression Language (CEL): pure, typed and bounded, checked against the type's fields when the plugin is validated.

rules.description: Rules every save of the type's records keeps, by name, on every path: the web app, the API, agents, runs' results and bulk imports. Each is a `check`, a combination of fields that is `unique` in a project, or a range that mustn't overlap another (`no_overlap`). The last two the database holds.

check.description: CEL that is true of every record that keeps the rule, reading the record as `record` (its fields, and one step into what they refer to: `record.instrument.service`), and `now` and `today`. A check that can't be worked out because a value it reads is empty passes, as a database's CHECK does: make the field `required` to require it.

when.description: CEL: the check applies only to records it's true of.

recheck_before_signing.description: Check this rule again on each signed state transition, including records saved under an earlier rule.

reference_revisions.description: Read these references at their recorded revisions when evaluating this check. Each value names an integer field on this record.

additionalProperties.description: The integer field holding the revision of this reference's record that the check reads.

fields.description: The fields a failure points at, in forms and the API's errors. Without it, the fields its check reads.

hold.description: A save that breaks the check is kept rather than refused, as a result out of its specification must be: whoever saves it says why, and the record is held until someone with one of these lab roles, other than whoever held it, reviews it. A held record can't be set to a state that locks it.

reviewed_by.description: The lab roles that can review a held record, such as `qa`.

unique.description: One field or a combination of fields whose values two records in a project cannot share. A record with any of them empty doesn't count. The database refuses a second, whatever writes it.

no_overlap.description: A range no two of a project's records' ranges overlap, such as two bookings of one instrument: from one field to another, each a date, a datetime, an int or a float. A range includes where it starts but not where it ends, so one booking can end as the next starts; dates include both. The database refuses an overlap, whatever writes it.

from.description: The field the range starts at.

to.description: The field the range ends at.

per.description: Records' ranges overlap only if they have the same values of these fields: per instrument, say.

while.description: For `unique` and `no_overlap`: only records whose fields have one of these values count, such as tubes whose status is `stored`, or bookings that aren't cancelled. Each is an enum, state or bool field of the same table.

additionalProperties.description: The values of this field that count, such as `[stored]`: states, an enum's values, or `true` or `false`.

rule.description: One rule: exactly one of `check`, `unique` and `no_overlap`.

guards.description: Named conditions on an operation. Each must pass or the operation is refused with its message.

guard.description: One guard: a `check` the operation must pass, and the `message` a person sees when it doesn't.

check.description: CEL that must be true for the operation to proceed. One that can't be worked out refuses the change.

when.description: CEL: the guard applies only when it's true.

expression.description: A CEL expression that is true or false, at most 1,000 characters.

message.description: What a person is told when it isn't kept, shown as text (never HTML). It can include CEL between `{{` and `}}`, such as `Purity is {{ record.purity }}%`.
